content: This is a channel where I will post everything I think other DM's might need to know about Hampstead content, so if a player pulls you into something there, you will have something to go off of.
To start off, every major NPC, Location, and Event for the entire run of the game is in this document: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1J_ex2QXbL5UvrkZZgxw7N62vulHzZm51ekxn6ZZKYIc/edit?usp=sharing
it has bookmarks for quick navigating on the left side

So anytime players are out and about in Hampstead, assume redcoat are nearby, and feel free (read you are encouraged to) bother players that are out in the open.

likewise, at night, definitely ask players for their papers to be out during curfew

_ _
Any character brought back via Frankensteining, even if they kept their original race, should be encouraged to play a level of dysphoria as parts of their body are not originally theirs.

_ _
Aljarad Smith is a fiend that plays the role of a really nice and kind old man.  Offer tea, and make sure to note that hours later the players that drink the tea suddenly have levels of damnation

_ _
(If any DM needs to drop info about things Hampstead NPC's talked about, or promised, make a note of it here so that we are on the same page.  I expect Crane, and to a lesser degree myself to do most of the Hampstead stuff, but it is possible that any DM might be needed, especially when it comes to bringing someone back, or preforming surgery)

Note to DMs, if anyone drinks the tea at <#851195612049309766> they gain two levels of damnation a few hours later.  If thy decide to discuss swarms/hive insects with mr. smith over tea, they will gain another one.
Also I've got a few potential pieces of art to use for Kolro
Let me know which of these appeals to you
gonna make a new channel to use for eldon's hanging
